newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Trading stays in line after hours.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Trading stays in line after hours.

text.p: Traders said stocks traded lightly after hours on Tuesday while investors waited for the book-to-bill ratio figures.
"We do expect book to bill to come out later this evening but we aren't seeing anything ahead of that," a trader said.
ITT Corp traded in line with its close of 48-1/8, after falling 7-7/8. The company said it expected third-quarter results to fall below forecasts because of gaming revenue shortfalls.

Also during market hours, H.J. Heinz shares rose 1-1/4 to close at 33 after the company said it was on track to meet analysts' quarterly and year-end estimates and was considering selling some of its assets.
The New York Stock Exchange said its session one volume was 35,100 shares compared to 131,100 shares on Monday. Session two volume was 1,251,700 shares compared to 515,600 shares on Monday.
The American Stock Exchange said it had no after-hours volume.
